slug: 2025-07-26 Eritrea's population digital identity - challenges ahead

facts.fact: The profile states Eritrea has no operational foundational digital ID and no foundational ID exists yet.
The UK Home Office guidance says Eritrea issues national ID cards, which are required for an Eritrean passport.
The US State Department says Eritrea began issuing new plastic national identity cards with the holder's fingerprint in late 2015 for people over 18, though very few are in circulation.

note: Telecom application page; an identity card copy is required but no ID system is described.

facts.fact: The Eritrean embassy in Washington says Eritreans aged 18 or above must obtain a national ID and describes how new and replacement IDs are issued.

facts.fact: The Eritrean Consulate General in Frankfurt page of 11 August 2026 describes issuing and replacing the new national ID card, with fingerprints taken through the Consular Affairs Processing System (CAPS) and a bar on applying twice.
